notes: Easy and long runs use distance targets when their structure supports them. Time estimates help you plan; run-walk, recoveries and timed quality sessions keep their prescribed durations.

Half-marathon preparation uses the advanced running-capacity band. Weekly distance and the first long run start from your declared routine. Later long runs progress in whole kilometres or hold, within your available time and weekly allocation.

Your 0 weekday workouts are separate from the easy long run. Recovery weeks reduce the workload; the final 14 days taper toward race day. Workout doses follow your background and planned exposures, not spare time in your schedule.
Progression is a forecast. Missed sessions are never added to later workouts.
Independent training rules; coaching review and real-watch validation are still pending.
